verdict.rationale: Vercel's docs explicitly describe incremental rollout with percentage-based traffic splitting and promote/rollback controls (vercel-docs-6, vercel-docs-28), plus instant rollback for recovery (vercel-docs-5, vercel-docs-29), directly matching the story of reducing blast radius via incremental deploys. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of gradual rollout behavior in practice, and no detail on automated rollout policies (e.g., canary analysis or auto-rollback thresholds).
